create.name: WCCM Australia (Australian Christian Meditation Community)
create.bio:
WCCM Australia is the Australian national community of the World Community for Christian Meditation. Its roots go back to a Melbourne couple, John and Mila Little, who meditated with John Main in Montreal in the 1970s and on their return began the first Australian group in their home at Mount Martha; by the mid-1990s a national community was forming, with groups in every state. It teaches Main's way of contemplative prayer: twice daily, sitting still and silently repeating a prayer word, setting aside thoughts and images to rest in God's presence.

Groups meet in parishes, homes and schools across the country, and the community runs a school of meditation for newcomers and group leaders, programmes for younger meditators and children, and an audio and video library. Its calendar lists quiet days and short retreats in different states, such as an introduction and renewal day at St Benedict's Monastery in Arcadia and an Advent quiet day in the Blue Mountains, plus a joint pilgrimage retreat with New Zealand at Bonnevaux in France.

courses.title: Meditation Introduction and Renewal Day
courses.description: A day at St Benedict's Monastery, Arcadia (NSW) for newcomers learning to meditate and for meditators renewing their practice.

courses.title: Advent Twilight Retreat
courses.description: An evening of silent meditation, prayer and reflection for Advent at St Theodore's in Toorak Gardens, Adelaide; open to beginners.
courses.price: Free entry | Bookings essential | Donations Welcome

courses.title: A Quiet Day
courses.description: A day of shared meditation, silence and reflection in Blackheath with Rev Linda Chapman on the hidden language of nature.

courses.title: Australia and New Zealand National Community Retreat
courses.description: A five-day residential pilgrimage retreat at Bonnevaux Abbey in France, with daily meditation, contemplative walks and silence.

free_resources.title: Audio & Video
free_resources.description: A library of recorded talks and teachings on Christian meditation.
